title: Money cases: deadlines and ended reply watchers
context: Owner asked (nightly review 23 Oct) for one place for open money cases (refunds, disputes, failed or unexpected charges, debts) with a ping before each deadline, so nothing is dropped. The cases live in ~/Documents/assistant/money-cases/cases.json; use the money-cases CLI, never edit the file by hand. This fires when a case is due within 24h, is overdue (once a day), or a reply watcher linked to it ended while the case is still open. On fire: run money-cases show ID, check msgs and ~/Documents/assistant/activity-log.md for news, then text the owner one short line per case: amount, merchant, reference, what happened, the next action and its deadline, and 2-3 options (for an ended reply watcher: chase again with a new watcher, take the next step, or close). Then record it: money-cases update ID --state ... --next ... --deadline ... (or close ID --outcome ...). A new deadline stops repeat pings. Finance rules: no payment, dispute, cancellation or message to a merchant without the owner's OK; never print card numbers, passwords or OTPs; if the owner drops a money note, follow the personal-finance skill. No pings 23:00-08:00 Dubai; the check holds them.
